import.intro: Upload an Excel workbook, review its rows, then confirm the import.
import.templateHint: The template contains sample teams and a match. Edit or remove the samples before uploading. Staff must already exist in the member directory.
import.fileHint: Choose a non-empty .xlsx file, up to 5 MiB.
import.upsertHint: Matches existing teams and games by code and rounds by number. Adds new rows and never deletes existing setup.
import.replaceHint: Deletes the event’s teams, games, rounds, matches and referee/guide assignments before importing. Event admins are preserved. Only allowed for a draft event with no round ever started.
import.previewHint: Counts describe workbook rows. Expand a section to review up to the first 100 rows. Existing rows may be updated by UPSERT.
import.errorsHint: Nothing has been imported. Fix these rows in Excel and upload the workbook again.
import.valid: Workbook and server checks passed. Review the import before confirming.
import.confirmUpsert: Import these rows into this event? Existing rows with matching codes or round numbers will be updated; new rows will be added.
import.confirmReplace: Replace this event’s setup? All existing teams, games, rounds, matches and referee/guide assignments will be deleted and replaced with this workbook. Event admin assignments are preserved.
import.atomicHint: The server checks every row again. All rows are saved together, or none are saved.
import.invalidFile: Choose a non-empty .xlsx workbook no larger than 5 MiB.
import.parseFailed: This workbook could not be read. Check that it is a valid .xlsx file and try again.
import.loadFailed: Event setup could not be loaded. Check your connection and access, then try again.
import.validationFailed: Server checks could not finish. Check your connection and choose Check again.
import.applyFailed: The import response could not be received. Check your connection and confirm again to safely retry the same import.
import.applyRejected: The server rejected the import. Review the errors below and check the workbook again.
import.downloadFailed: The template could not be created. Please try again.

paragraphs.text: Founded in 2011, Demiana Sports Team (DST) is a Christian sports ministry serving the youth of St. Demiana Church in Haram. We believe that sports are more than just games or competitions; they are a powerful way to build character, strengthen relationships, and reflect Christian values in everyday life. Through sports, we aim to create an environment where young people grow in faith, discipline, teamwork, responsibility, respect, and love. Our mission is not simply to develop better athletes, but to inspire better people who demonstrate the spirit of Christ both on and off the field. Guided by one simple question, "
paragraphs.after: ", we strive to make every game, every challenge, and every interaction an opportunity to live out our faith, support one another, and lead by example.
